item.title: Open Night Train Database (ONTD)
item.description:
Back-on-Track Europe
The Open Night Train Database is Back-on-Track Europe's database of night trains in Europe: routes, trips, stops, operators, calendars and travel classes, in a structure inspired by GTFS. Volunteers keep it up to date in a shared spreadsheet, and it powers the night train map on back-on-track.eu. This record archives a release of the GitHub repository Back-on-Track-eu/night-train-data.

item.title: BLIND ACCESS TO PERSONAL AUTONOMY
item.description:
Priyanka Kiran Khawale
The greatest lie on the internet is the one any user repeats daily by clicking "I have read and agree" without actually reading a single page. Privacy Policy, an important legal document that ensures transparency between the companies and internet users yet it rarely achieves that purpose. Users often tend to accept the privacy policy without reading them, as access to the service depends on acceptance. This raises a question whether such consent obtained is legally meaningful?
